findings.title: Template depends on examples/hello model API
findings.message: The new template main.go calls `model.view(...)` with a hint node, but model.go is still copied from examples/hello and may define a different signature for `counter` and `view`. This couples the template to an unrelated example, so a change to hello's model can break generated apps without any test noticing. The template can fail to compile if hello's model.go does not accept a node argument.
findings.suggestion: Ship the template's own model.go (and its test) in scripts/templates/app, or add a test that generates an app and runs `go build ./...` to catch drift.
findings.evidence: return model.view(ui.Node{ID: "hint", Kind: ui.Label, Text: "Build your application using public Go APIs."})
